messages.text: What are the most important signal generation capabilities for applications in AI?

知識庫未把 AI 應用中的 signal generation capabilities 做重要性排名；可由已列規格整理出的關鍵能力是：寬頻 ARB / baseband、長 waveform memory、多載波 / 多段 waveform、I/Q modulation 品質、低相位雜訊 / spectral purity、digital I/Q 介面、以及標準波形產生 / 播放能力。[2][17][25][26][28][31][45]
| Capability | Supported details |
|---|---|
| 寬頻 ARB / baseband signal generation | R&S SMCV100B base instrument includes a baseband generator with ARB at 64 Msample and 60 MHz RF bandwidth, and baseband bandwidth extension options reach 120 MHz, 160 MHz, and 240 MHz RF bandwidth.[45] |
| 長 waveform memory | R&S SMCV100B ARB waveform length is 1 sample to 64 Msample standard, 512 Msample with R&S®SMCVB-K511, and 1 Gsample with R&S®SMCVB-K512.[2] |
| 高 sample rate / RF bandwidth | R&S SMCV100B ARB sample rate is 400 Hz to 75 MHz standard, and can reach 150 MHz, 200 MHz, or 300 MHz with R&S®SMCVB-K521 / K522 / K523; arbitrary waveform mode RF bandwidth reaches 60 MHz standard and 240 MHz with K523.[2] |
| 多段與多載波 waveform | R&S SMCV100B multisegment waveform mode supports 1 to 1024 segments, and multicarrier waveform mode supports up to 512 carriers with total RF bandwidth up to 240 MHz with K523.[2] |
| I/Q modulation bandwidth and quality | R&S SMCV100B internal baseband I/Q modulation supports maximum RF modulation bandwidth up to ±120 MHz, and with R&S®SMCVB-K547 the frequency response specification up to 240 MHz RF modulation bandwidth is < 1.2 dB and < 0.3 dB measured.[25] |
| Modulation accuracy | R&S SMCV100B has measured modulation error ratio > 40 dB under the cited single-carrier 64QAM test condition.[25] |
| Low phase noise / spectral purity | R&S SMCV100B spectral purity includes harmonics, nonharmonics, wideband noise, SSB phase noise, residual FM, and residual AM; with R&S®SMCVB-K709, SSB phase-noise limits improve, for example to < –125 dBc at 1 GHz and 20 kHz offset.[28] |
| Digital I/Q connectivity | R&S SMCV100B with R&S®SMCVB-K19 provides Dig. I/Q HS compliant with R&S®Digital I/Q interface 40G, using QSFP+/QSFP 28, with digital baseband input sample rate 400 Hz to 300 MHz and I/Q data up to 16 bit.[26] |
| Standard-specific waveform generation / playback | R&S CMP180 supports waveform creator, standard-specific waveform playback, and R&S VSE analysis options; waveform playback options include NB-IoT, LP-IoT, UWB, Bluetooth, WLAN, GSM, WCDMA, CDMA2000, LTE, LTE C-V2X, NR, and NR sidelink.[17] |
| Predefined waveform libraries | R&S CMP180 ordering information lists predefined waveform options including non-cellular, cellular, GPRF, GNSS, NB-IoT, LP-IoT, UWB, Bluetooth, WLAN, GSM, WCDMA, CDMA2000, LTE, LTE C-V2X, NR Rel. 15/16, NR Rel. 17, and NR C-V2X.[31] |
【推論】For AI data-center and AI-server-related test contexts, the most defensible signal-generation priorities from these passages are wide RF/baseband bandwidth, long and flexible waveform generation, high modulation quality, low phase noise, and digital I/Q interoperability, because the passages document AI/data-center high-speed connectivity contexts separately from the signal-generator capabilities above.[35][45][2][25][26][28]

R&S SMCV100B › 適用條件與規格定義
依 [[SMCV100B_specs_en_3608-0627-22_v1700]]，產品資料適用條件：

- 在 ambient temperature 儲存 `3 小時` 後，warm-up operation `30 分鐘`。
- 符合指定 environmental conditions。
- 遵守 recommended calibration interval。
- 已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

規格定義：

- Specifications with limits：以範圍或限制值表示 warranted product performance，使用 `<, ≤, >, ≥, ±, maximum, minimum` 等標示。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits (`n. trc.`)：依 specifications with limits 測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：代表 warranted product performance，通常為尺寸或設定解析度等無或可忽略偏差的值。
- Typical data (`typ.`)：代表約 `80%` 量產儀器可達到的性能，或代表平均值。
- Nominal values (`nom.`)：代表性數值，不做 statistical evaluation，生產時不測試。
- Measured values (`meas.`)：來自個別樣品的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor = `2`，依 GUM 規則計算，考慮 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

R&S SMCV100B › Arbitrary waveform generator
| 條件 | Waveform length |
|---|---|
| Standard | `1 sample to 64 Msample`, one-sample steps |
| with `R&S®SMCVB-K511` | `1 sample to 512 Msample` |
| with `R&S®SMCVB-K512` | `1 sample to 1 Gsample` |

Sample rate：standard `400 Hz to 75 MHz`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K521` `400 Hz to 150 MHz`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K522` `400 Hz to 200 MHz`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K523` `400 Hz to 300 MHz`；HDD streaming standard `400 Hz to 75 MHz` 需 `R&S®SMCVB-K505`。

Arbitrary waveform mode RF bandwidth：standard maximum sample rate `60 MHz`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K521` `120 MHz`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K522` `160 MHz`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K523` `240 MHz`。Frequency offset setting range：standard `–30 MHz to 30 MHz`；with `K521` `–60 MHz to 60 MHz`；with `K522` `–80 MHz to 80 MHz`；with `K523` `–120 MHz to 120 MHz`。

Triggering and markers：trigger source internal 或 external；trigger modes auto、retrig、armed auto、armed retrig、single；external trigger input selectable from user 1 or user 2，`BNC female`，input level `0 V to 3 V nominal`，threshold `0.1 V to 2.0 V`，input impedance selectable `1 kΩ` or `50 Ω nominal`，trigger jitter `±1.67 ns`。Marker signals number `1`，operating modes unchanged、restart、pulse、pattern、ratio，level `LVTTL`。

Multisegment waveform mode：segments `1 to 1024`，changeover modes GUI、remote control、external trigger，sequencer play list length max. `1024`，segment repetitions max. `1048575`。

Multicarrier waveform mode：carriers max. `512`；total RF bandwidth standard `60 MHz`，with `K521` `120 MHz`，with `K522` `160 MHz`，with `K523` `240 MHz`。

- 來源：[[SMCV100B_specs_en_3608-0627-22_v1700]]
- 文件名稱：`R&S®SMCV100B Vector Signal Generator Specifications`

- 文件版本：`Version 17.00`
- 文件日期：來源開頭標示 `September 2025`；文件資訊頁標示 `August 2025`，見 [[SMCV100B_specs_en_3608-0627-22_v1700]] 的未解問題。
- 產品名稱：`R&S®SMCV100B Vector Signal Generator`
- Base instrument order no.：`1432.7000.02`

R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

R&S CMP180 › 產品定位
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 Radio Communication Tester。依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]，文件涵蓋 global options、Bluetooth、CDMA2000、GSM、LP-IoT、LTE、NB-IoT、NR、spectrum analysis、UWB、WCDMA、WLAN、[[R&S VSE]] options 與 ordering information。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]，CMP180 支援 simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing，並提供 RF generator/analyzer no. 1 與可選 RF generator/analyzer no. 2 的多埠 RF 測試架構。

R&S CMP180 › 文件依據與版本
本頁目前依兩份 Productions 來源整理：

- [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]：文件識別碼 **1179.5118.02**，**Version 09**，對應 software **V11.9 or higher**，版權標示 © 2026；此文件是 test applications overview，並明示量測範圍與 tolerance limits 需參考 specifications document **PD 3609.7348.22**。
- [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]：文件識別碼 **PD 3609.7348.22**，**Version 08.00**，日期 **March 2026**；此文件提供 specifications、general data、ordering information、warranty 與 service。

- [[full-spectrum-data-center-connectivity-brochure]] 未標示正式日期；所有產品能力、規格數字與 marketing claim 需標示來源日期缺口。
- 來源是供應商 brochure，不是第三方市場報告；不可用來推論市占率、排名、客戶導入、採購關係或出貨量。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › High-speed electrical connectivity
- [[Amphenol OverPass Cable Systems]] — 來源稱其 enable high-speed signal transmission from ASIC packages to end-points across the system。
- [[ExtremePort OSFP Connectors]] — 來源稱 connectors and cages have 60 contacts per port、0.6 mm pitch，並 optimized for signal integrity、thermal management and multi-lane pluggable architecture。
- [[Amphenol XtremePass]] — 來源稱 XtremePass 448G connector solution supports scalable form factors from 32DP to 128DP，並跨 Ethernet、NVLink、PCIe、InfiniBand systems。
- [[OSFP Cable Assemblies]] — 來源稱 OSFP cable assemblies compatible with 25G/lane NRZ up to 224G/lane PAM4，deliver aggregate bandwidths of 200G、400G、800G and 1.6T per cable assembly，available in Passive and Active variants。
- [[Sentry HD High-Speed Backplane Connector]] — 來源稱其是 next-generation high-speed backplane connector platform。
- [[Celerity 224 Gb-s BGA Mezzanine Connectors]] — 來源稱其 designed to support data rates up to 224 Gb/s PAM4。

S-SSS › 基本性質
依 [[S-SSB]]：

- [[S-SSS]] 是 [[Sidelink SSB]] / [[S-SS-PSBCH block]] 的四個組成之一。
- Like standard [[SSS]]，[[S-SSS]] consists of 127 [[BPSK]] modulation symbols。
- Sequence is based on two Fibonacci [[LFSR]]s of length 7：
  - `x0` with taps [7,3]。
  - `x1` with taps [7,6]。
- Final sequence `d` is obtained by interleaving the two LFSR outputs depending on the [[Sidelink identity]]，in same way as standard [[SSS]]；但來源中的完整公式 / identity 符號因轉檔遺失。
- Overall 672 different S-SSS sequences are defined because sequence generation depends on the first and second ID。

| Capability | Supported details |
|---|---|
| 寬頻 ARB / baseband signal generation | R&S SMCV100B base instrument includes a baseband generator with ARB at 64 Msample and 60 MHz RF bandwidth, and baseband bandwidth extension options reach 120 MHz, 160 MHz, and 240 MHz RF bandwidth.[45] |
| 長 waveform memory | R&S SMCV100B ARB waveform length is 1 sample to 64 Msample standard, 512 Msample with R&S®SMCVB-K511, and 1 Gsample with R&S®SMCVB-K512.[2] |
| 高 sample rate / RF bandwidth | R&S SMCV100B ARB sample rate is 400 Hz to 75 MHz standard, and can reach 150 MHz, 200 MHz, or 300 MHz with R&S®SMCVB-K521 / K522 / K523; arbitrary waveform mode RF bandwidth reaches 60 MHz standard and 240 MHz with K523.[2] |
| 多段與多載波 waveform | R&S SMCV100B multisegment waveform mode supports 1 to 1024 segments, and multicarrier waveform mode supports up to 512 carriers with total RF bandwidth up to 240 MHz with K523.[2] |
| I/Q modulation bandwidth and quality | R&S SMCV100B internal baseband I/Q modulation supports maximum RF modulation bandwidth up to ±120 MHz, and with R&S®SMCVB-K547 the frequency response specification up to 240 MHz RF modulation bandwidth is < 1.2 dB and < 0.3 dB measured.[25] |
| Modulation accuracy | R&S SMCV100B has measured modulation error ratio > 40 dB under the cited single-carrier 64QAM test condition.[25] |
| Low phase noise / spectral purity | R&S SMCV100B spectral purity includes harmonics, nonharmonics, wideband noise, SSB phase noise, residual FM, and residual AM; with R&S®SMCVB-K709, SSB phase-noise limits improve, for example to < –125 dBc at 1 GHz and 20 kHz offset.[28] |
| Digital I/Q connectivity | R&S SMCV100B with R&S®SMCVB-K19 provides Dig. I/Q HS compliant with R&S®Digital I/Q interface 40G, using QSFP+/QSFP 28, with digital baseband input sample rate 400 Hz to 300 MHz and I/Q data up to 16 bit.[26] |
